dct_description_sm: A general sketch of the orography of Eastern Siberia by P. Kropotkin.

Na obshchegeograficheskoĭ karte vydeleny t︠s︡entry guberniĭ i uezdov. Pokazany kreposti, stanit︠s︡y, derevni, karauly, fabriki i zavody, rudniki, zolotye priiski, monastyri. Naneseny pochtovye i proselochnye dorogi.
Original map at: Russian State Library

Orography is a branch of the science of geomorphology that deals with the disposition and character of hills and mountains. The orography of a region concerns its elevated terrain. This general sketch of the orography of eastern Siberia and adjacent areas shows hills, plateaus, lowlands, mountain ranges, and other features. Also shown are provincial and district centers, fortresses, Cossack villages, guard posts, factories and plants, mines, gold fields, monasteries, and postal and country roads. World Digital Library.
